purpose_of_set: This group shows the expedition is for one form carried to every substrate a field brings: Natural Intelligence's opening is the logic's first 47 steps word for word, and Exhibit ONE's seventeen names are, by turns, a network's connectors ('An engineered surface's joins are across with 6→2 and 10→14 and along with 9→17'), numbers' places and parities ('A numeral within a name is a name's place and parity'), mathematics' moves ('two involutions fixing nothing at each scale') and logic's steps ('each step one logical extension from all steps before it, all or none at all'). Its aim is pattern-matching: 'Pattern matching opens with continuing relation with each crossing ... That same relation is sought with observed stable-forming of nature' (TWO 6.12), each finding with 'its complete comparison' and its instrument stated, so that 'Numbers, mathematics and logic are nature's own unrelationing binary method' (FOUR 1.2) and a field's hard problem is met as 'an involution with its fixed set taken as a place' (FOUR 7.8). What it asks of Natural Intelligence is that its title, subtitle and contents carry these four couplings by name and carry one resolver into them, since today a reader crosses from 3.5 into Exhibit ONE with no line saying what it is for, and networking still executes a resolver Exhibit ONE no longer is.
